release.title: NodeLink release-note gate rehearsal
release.intended_use: Validation rehearsal only; these synthetic artifacts are not deployable.

server.deployment: Run from the source commit identified by the release workflow.

database.migration_policy: Migrations are forward-only; restore an exact-revision verified backup when a schema rollback is required.

protocols.mixed_version_behavior: Dispatch remains unavailable until the agent advertises command-v3; there is no downgrade mode.

known_limitations: Windows executables are not Authenticode-signed and may trigger SmartScreen warnings.
Production backup scheduling and a timed operator rollback drill remain deployment evidence.
This rehearsal uses synthetic artifact payloads and must never be deployed.

prerequisites: Verify an encrypted backup and retain its immutable manifest before changing the database or server.
Confirm the server, dashboard, agent, Alembic revision, and command-envelope versions match this record.
steps: Pause command dispatch and external agent rollout automation.
Apply Alembic revision 0010, then deploy the server and dashboard from the recorded source commit.
Deploy the checksum-verified agent and installer to owned canary endpoints before expanding.
verification: Confirm the server revision guard passes and a known operator can authenticate.
Confirm canary agents advertise command-v3 and complete one benign command exactly once.
Verify the audit chain, external anchor publication, backup evidence, and release artifact attestations.

decision_path: Prefer a forward fix when the current schema can remain in place.
Redeploy the last-known-good components only when their required schema exactly matches the live database.
Otherwise preserve the failed state, approve the data-loss window, and restore the exact-revision verified backup.

security_impact.summary: The gate adds no runtime trust boundary; it prevents releases with incomplete compatibility, recovery, or security evidence.
fixed_vulnerabilities: No runtime vulnerability is claimed fixed by this release-note validation rehearsal.
new_risks: Authenticode signing remains absent, so checksum and provenance verification are still mandatory.
operator_actions: Review every manifest field and independently verify checksums, provenance, backup, and rollback evidence before deployment.
